notes: Pricing is a single feature-identical plan priced by a monthly-pageview slider ($15 to $470/month for 100k to 25M pageviews), plus a 'Custom' tier above 25M pageviews; plans have no names, so name_any is deliberately broad. Yearly billing is offered ('Get 2 months free (switch to yearly)') but no yearly amount is displayed, so only the monthly amounts are listed. 7-day free trial is a trial, not a free plan. Add-on: extra 50-site packs at $10/month or $100/year (add-on, not a plan). 'Trusted by ... over a million websites' and testimonials are company claims, not payment proof. Country CA is stated twice ('Canadian company', 'Canadian corporation'); the 'Anonymized analytics are stored on our US infrastructure' sentence must not be read as a US headquarters. A footer 'Affiliates' link is incidental: core purpose is web analytics, eligible. Founder (Jack Ellis) is named but no founding year or headcount is stated.
